title: UB Coverage Matrix
description: Disposition coverage of every miri-enumerated undefined-behavior class. One row per UB class records where the proof that the class cannot occur stops, and the pin that proves the foreclosure or anchors the obligation/gap. Spec Clause 4.5 (no silent undefined behavior).

rows.description: One row per UB class. Cardinality grows toward the full rustc UndefinedBehaviorInfo (37) + ValidationErrorKind (26) + miri detector set; this seed holds one row per disposition bucket.

disposition.description: Where the proof that this UB class cannot occur stops.

class_id.description: rustc UndefinedBehaviorInfo / ValidationErrorKind variant name, or a miri runtime-detector class (e.g. DataRace).

miri_source.description: Upstream enumeration source, repo-relative (e.g. rust: rustc_middle/src/mir/interpret/error.rs UndefinedBehaviorInfo::AlignmentCheckFailed).

ori_mechanism.description: The Ori invariant/mechanism and spec clause that dispositions this class.

pin_ref.description: Ori-side pin: a compiler_repo-relative file or file::symbol that proves the foreclosure, anchors the obligation, or (for a gap) cites the hardening anchor. The checker fails closed when this is empty.
